lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 distinct high-contrast vertical white segments are visible across the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section but increases in density near the shoulder and posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is observed in the lower-mid section of the torso where two vertical lines converge toward the ventral line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior lines and the final two posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before the ventral-most region of the torso mass. Several mid-body lines exhibit a dashed or broken topology near the belly.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the upper hind limb/posterior flank region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three white spots on the mid-posterior thigh align to form a semi-connected horizontal geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patches are visible on the distal limbs just above the hooves, and a white transverse band is present on the lower foreleg above the carpus.
